213d8b5b428f63b0.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is building a global practice for Managed Service Providers from zero: The program, the proposition, and the wins that prove it out. As Senior Solutions Architect, MSP, you're the technical front line: helping define how Everpure goes to market with MSPs, then taking that straight to the field to win deals. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with MSP architects and their end customers, fluent in cost-per-tenant economics one minute and whiteboarding architecture the next. There's no playbook yet; you'll be building it and proving it, deal by deal.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own technical leadership of MSP opportunities end to end: discovery, solution design, sizing, competitive positioning, POCs and technical close.
  • Define the end-to-end service architecture — multi-tenancy, automation, provisioning, operational model and integration into the MSP's existing stack.
  • Model and influence the commercial construct: unit economics, cost per tenant, Evergreen//One and consumption models.
  • Displace competitors in MSP environments and position the full platform — FlashArray, FlashBlade, Portworx and Everpure Data Intelligence.
  • Build technical credibility with MSP architects, practice leads and CTOs, growing a population of partner-side technical champions.
  • Feed real MSP requirements back into the global MSP programme and Product Management, contributing reusable IP — reference architectures, sizing guides, service blueprints — from live engagements.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years in pre-sales, solutions architecture or technical leadership, with a demonstrable record of winning partner-led business.
  • Direct experience with MSPs, with a real understanding of how they build, price, operate and sell a managed service.
  • Credible at depth across modern data platform architecture: block, file and object, hybrid and cloud data services, Kubernetes and storage-as-a-service models.
  • Commercial fluency — comfortable discussing consumption economics, TCO and margin with an MSP's finance and practice leadership.
  • Outstanding written, diagrammatic and verbal communication, with the executive presence to move between a CTO conversation and a whiteboard session.
  • Entrepreneurial and ambitious — comfortable building a practice rather than inheriting one.

#LI-REMOTE

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

217d77dec07edf26.description:
Sales, at its core, is about one thing: generating revenue for the company by solving real business problems for clients. This role is designed for individuals who understand that in any professional sales environment, achieving defined revenue targets is the primary and most important responsibility.

From day 1, you are expected to embrace the hustle of outbound sales prospecting, follow-ups, negotiations, rejections, and consistent target chasing. This is a hardcore, performance-driven sales role, and success is measured by measurable revenue outcomes. This clarity ensures transparency, fairness, and high growth opportunities for those who perform.

Performance evaluation period (first 3 months):

The first three (3) months will be treated as a structured performance evaluation period focused primarily on outbound sales.

During this phase:

A. Outbound cold calling and self-generated revenue are mandatory
B. Minimum expectation:
1. 2 qualified closures per week ( 40,000+ ticket size recommended)
2. 2,00,000 monthly revenue target
3. At least 90% achievement of 2L monthly revenue is required

C. Performance will be reviewed weekly under the structured flag framework
D. This phase is designed to fairly evaluate:
1. Sales consistency
2. Revenue generation ability
3. Discipline and ownership
4. Long-term suitability for higher responsibilities

Weekly performance flag system (during evaluation period):

Green flag - strong performance:
1. Weekly and revenue benchmarks met
2. Salary, incentives, and perks remain applicable
3. Indicates readiness for growth

Orange flag - improvement required:
1. Around 50% of the weekly closure target was achieved
2. Immediate improvement expected next week
3. Two consecutive Orange Flags may escalate to Blue

Blue flag - monitoring & performance support phase:
1. Revenue benchmarks not achieved
2. Fixed salary and perks may be paused
3. Engagement may transition temporarily into an incentive-only/commission-based structure (with higher earning potential)
4. Two consecutive Blue Flags may escalate to Red

Red flag - exit consideration:
1. Continued underperformance despite monitoring
2. May trigger exit from the role and organization

Early Review Clause:

The 3-month evaluation review may be initiated earlier if:
1. 2 consecutive zero-closure weeks occur
2. 2 consecutive low-performance months occur
3. 2 consecutive months of unachieved revenue targets occur

Key Responsibilities:

A. Revenue generation & outbound sales:
1. Generate revenue through cold calling, email outreach, and networking
2. Prospect, qualify, and close deals independently
3. Own the entire sales cycle from first contact to closure
4. Maintain disciplined follow-ups and pipeline activity

B. Market research & lead generation:
1. Identify target industries and decision-makers
2. Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline
3. Identify new revenue opportunities

C. Client engagement & sales conversion:
1. Understand the client's business needs
2. Present customized IT and digital solutions
3. Deliver sales presentations and product demos
4. Secure new contracts

D. Relationship management:
1. Build professional relationships with business owners and CXOs
2. Coordinate internally for smooth onboarding

E. Sales target achievement:
1. Meet and exceed monthly revenue targets
2. Maintain strong pipeline discipline

F. CRM & reporting:
1. Maintain accurate CRM records
2. Weekly and monthly performance reports

Post Successful 3-Month Performance Phase: Upon consistent performance and meeting revenue benchmarks:

1. Access to CRM systems will be provided
2. Warm leads and inbound sales opportunities will be assigned
3. Responsibilities expand to relationship management and account growth
4. Higher revenue ownership and accelerated career progression opportunities follow
5. Greater stability in compensation structure and role expansion

Career Growth Path:

Business Development Executive
Senior BDE
Business Growth Manager
Regional Sales Lead
Head of Sales

Promotions are strictly performance-based, not tenure-based.
